rationale: The position is flat after 44 minutes, but the long structure is still intact — price holds above both session VWAP ($51.87) and the 9-EMA ($51.99), and the stock is showing relative strength by trading at 90% of its range near the session high despite a gap-down open and a weak SPY tape. The recent 1-minute fade from 52.06 to 52.02 on declining volume looks like midday consolidation rather than distribution, and the defined invalidation at $51.84 (just below VWAP) keeps risk-to-reward near 2:1 toward the $52.42 target.
